name: erfana
description: An orchestration toolkit for Claude Code and Qwen Code. Six orchestration skills (agent, article, issue, report, skill, spec) including the Modernize operation that applies Claude 5 patterns to existing skills and the Display operation in issue (single / list / search modes), one process skill (grill-me) for Socratic plan / design stress-testing, one verification skill (fact-checking) that traces atomic factual claims in analysis documents to source passages and applies user-approved corrections, three prompt-authoring skills (prompt for Claude 5 prompts, draft-goal for /goal completion conditions, raise-the-bar for making a request more ambitious before running it), four work-session skills (autopilot for unattended runs that survive restarts, next-batch for picking free issues, coordinate for issue claims across parallel sessions, expert-panel for specialist plan and design review), two user-invoked session-closeout skills (ship for commit / push / PR / merge / cleanup, handoff for a portable handoff document), 33 shared agents with per-agent effort/model overrides, the using-erfana router, six safety hooks (bash-safety, secret-detector, post-compact-reminder, verify-completion, grill-guard, ms-grill-guard), and five slash commands (doc-update, project-status, session-status, lens-review, explain-issue).
